claims.statement: Jack King says he has $50 in Tom Allen's hands for a fight between Allen and Mike Boden, and asks Allen to cover it and arrange a match.
claims.excerpt:
Thave $50in Tom Allen’s hands to fight
Mike Boden, any style he may mention.

claims.statement: According to Jack King, Tom Allen has been talking about fighting anybody in St. Louis.
claims.excerpt:
He has been talking about fighting anybody in
St. Louls.

quotes.speaker: Jack King
quotes.text: He has been talking about fighting anybody in St. Louls. Now, ifhe means fight let him cover this money and arrange a match for a purse and stake.

notes: Allen appears only in Jack King's letter; the claim is one side's. The letter is undated; printed 1891-01-17.
